Decision Required: Whether approved organisational accounts, licences, subscriptions or credit budgets already exist for Censys, VirusTotal and Recorded Future.
Why Required: Live commercial access may require paid licences or credits.
Decision Owner Role: Mentor / project owner with budget and vendor authority
Available Decision Options: Approved accounts and bounded budget available; Some vendors approved; No commercial access for this release; Decision deferred
Recommended Secure Default: No live commercial calls until vendor-specific approval is recorded.
Release-Safe Fallback: Complete adapters offline; show accurate Need Approval/Licence Required state
What Remains Disabled: Live Censys Platform, VirusTotal and Recorded Future calls and paid-source coverage.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: Yes, subject to all other release gates, only when commercial calls remain disabled, the offline fallback is implemented and tested, and disabled states are truthful.
Prohibited Claim: Do not claim live Censys, VirusTotal or Recorded Future coverage.
Notes: Record vendor-by-vendor account, licence, budget, quota, permitted-use, retention and credential-owner limits without recording secret values.

Decision Required: Censys entitlement, token owner role, approved endpoints, approved response fields and credit budget.
Why Required: Public research access does not establish Platform API entitlement.
Decision Owner Role: Mentor / project owner and named organisational credential owner
Available Decision Options: Approved for fixed-policy staging use; Approved with endpoint, field or credit limits; Not approved; Deferred
Release-Safe Fallback: Censys adapter complete with mocks; live disabled
Cost or Licence Impact: Potential Censys subscription or usage credits.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: Yes, subject to all other release gates, only when live enrichment remains disabled and the mocked fallback and truthful state are verified.
Prohibited Claim: Do not represent public Censys publication collection as Censys Platform enrichment.
Notes: Record the product entitlement, exact endpoints, allowed fields, credit ceiling, token-owner role, secret-reference identifier, rotation expectation and retention rules; never record the token.

Decision Required: Whether metadata-only VirusTotal use is permitted under the organisational account and API tier.
Why Required: Public or community access may not permit company production use.
Decision Owner Role: Mentor / project owner and named organisational credential owner
Available Decision Options: Metadata-only staging use approved; Approved with quotas and field restrictions; Not approved; Deferred
Cost or Licence Impact: Potential commercial tier, quota or licence cost.
What Remains Disabled: Live VirusTotal metadata requests; file upload, malware sample submission and binary retrieval remain prohibited in all states.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: Yes, subject to all other release gates, only when live requests remain disabled and the offline metadata adapter is implemented and tested.
Prohibited Claim: Do not claim live VirusTotal enrichment, file upload, malware submission, sample retrieval or binary retrieval.
Notes: Record permitted business use, tier, endpoints, fields, quota, retention, redistribution, credential-owner role, secret reference and rotation expectation; never record an API key.

Decision Required: Whether a Recorded Future subscription exists and which modules, endpoints and fields are licensed.
Why Required: Live endpoints depend on organisational entitlement.
Decision Owner Role: Mentor / project owner and named organisational credential owner
Available Decision Options: Approved licensed modules; Approved with endpoint or quota restrictions; Not approved; Deferred
Release-Safe Fallback: Safe mocked adapter complete; live disabled
Cost or Licence Impact: Potential Recorded Future subscription or licensed-module cost.
What Remains Disabled: Recorded Future live requests and licensed-data coverage.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: Yes, subject to all other release gates, only when live requests remain disabled and the mocked fallback and Licence Required state are verified.
Prohibited Claim: Do not claim Recorded Future data coverage.
Notes: Record licensed modules, exact endpoints, allowed fields, quota, storage, retention, redistribution, credential-owner role, secret reference and rotation expectation; never record credentials.

Decision Required: Approval to automate each proposed UAE public source after terms, robots and source-policy review.
Why Required: Public accessibility does not automatically authorise scheduled collection.
Decision Owner Role: Mentor / project owner, with organisational legal or policy review where required
Available Decision Options: Approve named sources individually; Approve with cadence, path or field restrictions; Manual-only use; Not approved; Deferred
Cost or Licence Impact: Potential policy review and operational hosting cost; source-specific licence terms may apply.
What Remains Disabled: Every UAE automated collector without a source-specific approval record.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: Yes, subject to all other release gates, only when unapproved collectors remain disabled and fixture or mocked coverage is implemented and tested.
Prohibited Claim: Do not imply automated UAE-source coverage when collectors are disabled.
Notes: Record one decision per source with approved HTTPS host, paths, cadence, fields, robots and terms basis, owner, retention, redirect policy and review date.

Decision Required: Whether the two-hour production schedule is authorised, which timezone applies and who owns operations.
Why Required: Recurring collection creates traffic, quota use and operational responsibility.
Decision Owner Role: Mentor / project owner and staging operations owner
Available Decision Options: Approve every two hours in an explicit timezone; Approve staging rehearsal only; Approve a different bounded cadence; Not approved; Deferred
Recommended Secure Default: Use controlled staging only, with unapproved sources disabled.
Release-Safe Fallback: Schedule enabled in controlled staging only
Cost or Licence Impact: Potential quota, traffic, compute and operational-support cost.
What Remains Disabled: The recurring production schedule and every source lacking its own prerequisites; manual flows remain available.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: Yes, subject to all other release gates, through manual flows and only an explicitly approved controlled staging rehearsal; no production schedule claim is allowed.
Prohibited Claim: Do not claim a production schedule without approval.
Notes: Record timezone, cadence, operational owner, enabled-source set, overlap policy, retry and backoff bounds, pause authority and evidence window.

Decision Required: Hosting provider, environment owner and mentor access method for staging.
Decision Owner Role: Mentor / project owner and infrastructure owner
Available Decision Options: Approved hosted staging; Approved internal host or VM; Approved temporary controlled host; Local demonstration fallback accepted; Deferred
Recommended Secure Default: Do not deploy publicly until ownership and access are defined.
Cost or Licence Impact: Potential hosting, network, support or cloud cost.
What Remains Disabled: Public or remote staging deployment and mentor access outside the documented local environment.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: Only if the mentor explicitly accepts the documented local or controlled fallback; otherwise staging release cannot proceed.
Prohibited Claim: Do not claim mentor-accessible hosted staging or production deployment.
Notes: Record provider or host class, environment owner, access route, authentication boundary, network exposure, shutdown owner, support window and accepted local-fallback evidence.

Decision Required: Approved domain or subdomain and certificate or TLS owner.
Why Required: Secure routing requires controlled naming and certificate management.
Decision Owner Role: Mentor / project owner and domain/TLS administrator
Available Decision Options: Approved domain/subdomain and certificate owner; Approved internal hostname; Temporary controlled host with TLS-ready configuration; Local-only fallback; Deferred
Recommended Secure Default: Do not expose plain HTTP to untrusted networks.
Release-Safe Fallback: Local TLS-ready reverse proxy and host-file access
Cost or Licence Impact: Potential domain, certificate, DNS or managed-proxy cost.
What Remains Disabled: Public hostname, external routing and certificate activation; plain HTTP to untrusted networks remains prohibited.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: Yes, subject to all other release gates, only through the local TLS-ready fallback without a public-hostname claim.
Prohibited Claim: Do not claim approved domain ownership, active TLS or secure public routing.
Notes: Record hostname, owner role, DNS authority, renewal responsibility, certificate delivery mechanism, termination boundary and expiry or review date; never store private keys.

Decision Required: Database hosting model, operational owner, retention period and storage constraints.
Why Required: Availability, backup, data lifecycle and cost depend on these decisions.
Decision Owner Role: Mentor / project owner and database/infrastructure owner
Available Decision Options: Approved managed PostgreSQL; Approved self-hosted staging PostgreSQL; Approved with retention limits; Deferred
Recommended Secure Default: Use self-hosted staging with conservative bounded retention.
Release-Safe Fallback: Self-hosted staging PostgreSQL with conservative retention
Cost or Licence Impact: Potential managed-database, compute, storage, backup and transfer cost.
What Remains Disabled: Managed or production PostgreSQL hosting, unapproved retention and any unsupported availability or durability claim.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: Only if the mentor explicitly accepts the documented self-hosted staging fallback, retention boundary and owner; otherwise staging release cannot proceed.
Prohibited Claim: Do not claim approved production database hosting, retention, availability or recovery.
Notes: Record host class, database owner, retention period, storage limit, backup boundary, least-privilege roles, encryption, maintenance responsibility and accepted fallback evidence; never record a database URL.

Decision Required: Approved secret-management method and credential-delivery process.
Why Required: Production credentials require secure organisational handling.
Decision Owner Role: Mentor / project owner and security/infrastructure owner
Available Decision Options: Approved organisational secret manager; Approved Docker or platform-independent secret files or references for staging; No live paid credentials for this release; Deferred
Recommended Secure Default: Do not supply a live secret value until the delivery mechanism is approved.
Release-Safe Fallback: Docker secret references; no live paid credentials
Cost or Licence Impact: Potential secret-manager, vault or managed-platform cost.
What Remains Disabled: Live paid credentials, commercial integrations and production secret delivery.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: Yes, subject to all other release gates, only with secret references and no live paid credential or dependent integration enabled.
Prohibited Claim: Do not claim an approved secret manager or record secret values in the register, chat, Git, workbook or documentation.
Notes: Record provider or mechanism, owner role, reference-name convention, approved secure delivery route, access policy, rotation and revocation expectations; never store passwords, tokens, keys, private keys, database URLs, cookies or auth headers.

Decision Required: Approved backup destination, retention and owner.
Why Required: Off-host recovery requires approved storage and lifecycle controls.
Decision Owner Role: Mentor / project owner and backup/storage owner
Available Decision Options: Approved encrypted off-host destination; Approved controlled internal storage; Local encrypted rehearsal only; Deferred
Recommended Secure Default: Use an encrypted local rehearsal backup without claiming production recovery.
Cost or Licence Impact: Potential encrypted storage, retention, transfer or managed-backup cost.
What Remains Disabled: Production off-host backup, scheduled retention and production recoverability claims.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: Yes, subject to all other release gates, only with an implemented and tested encrypted local rehearsal fallback and no production recovery claim.
Prohibited Claim: Do not claim approved production backup, off-host retention, RPO, RTO or recoverability.
Notes: Record destination class, owner role, retention, encryption, access controls, deletion procedure, restore-test cadence, RPO, RTO and review date without recording credentials.

Decision Required: Operational monitoring method and authorised alert recipient.
Why Required: Alerts require ownership and may require paid tooling.
Decision Owner Role: Mentor / project owner and staging operations owner
Available Decision Options: Approved provider and recipient; Self-hosted logs and health checks; No external alerting for staging; Deferred
Recommended Secure Default: Use self-hosted logs and health checks with a named review-owner role.
Cost or Licence Impact: Potential monitoring, log retention, notification or on-call tooling cost.
What Remains Disabled: External alert delivery and paid monitoring integration; product Slack, Teams or email notification features remain outside this approval.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: Yes, subject to all other release gates, using self-hosted logs and health checks with an explicitly owned review process.
Prohibited Claim: Do not claim external operational alerting or a product Slack, Teams or email-alert feature.
Notes: Record monitoring method, owner role, authorised recipient role or channel reference, thresholds, retention, escalation, quiet hours and review date; do not record webhook URLs, tokens or recipient secrets.

Decision Required: Authorised staging users and acceptance of the local RBAC model.
Why Required: Accounts and access must be explicitly authorised.
Available Decision Options: Approve named users and roles; Approve role model but defer final user list; Require changes; Deferred
Recommended Secure Default: Create only minimal mentor and team accounts after approval.
Cost or Licence Impact: Potential identity-administration effort; external identity tooling may add cost.
What Remains Disabled: Staging user provisioning, shared or default accounts and access by any unauthorised user.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: Only if the mentor explicitly accepts the restricted local-access fallback and authorises the minimal user and role set; otherwise staging release cannot proceed.
Prohibited Claim: Do not claim authorised staging users, accepted RBAC or mentor access.
Notes: Record user identity reference, assigned role, approver role, account expiry and revocation owner only after approval; never record passwords or password hashes. B0-05 creates no users.

Decision Required: Whether company SSO is required for the staging release.
Why Required: Identity-provider integration may require organisational configuration.
Decision Owner Role: Mentor / project owner and identity administrator where applicable
Available Decision Options: SSO required and configuration will be supplied; SSO not required for staging and secure local RBAC accepted; SSO deferred post-submission; Decision pending
Recommended Secure Default: Require secure local RBAC regardless of SSO.
Cost or Licence Impact: Potential identity-provider licence, application-registration and administration cost.
What Remains Disabled: SSO integration and every SSO capability claim; secure local RBAC remains required.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: Yes, subject to all other release gates, only with secure local RBAC and no SSO claim.
Prohibited Claim: Do not claim SSO support without implementation and evidence.
Notes: Record whether SSO is required, identity-provider owner role, approved protocol and configuration delivery mechanism, local-RBAC acceptance, review date and evidence reference; never record client secrets.

Decision Required: Explicit acceptance of the deployed scope, disabled approval-gated sources, accepted limitations and residual risk.
Available Decision Options: Release accepted; Accepted with recorded conditions; Rejected pending remediation; Deferred
Recommended Secure Default: Do not release without explicit sign-off.
Release-Safe Fallback: No release without explicit sign-off record
Cost or Licence Impact: No direct vendor cost; unresolved hosting, remediation or operational conditions may affect release cost.
What Remains Disabled: The final release, release-acceptance claim and residual-risk acceptance.
Can Staging Release Proceed Without Appr: No; staging release cannot proceed without explicit authorised sign-off for the exact release candidate.
Prohibited Claim: Do not claim release acceptance, mentor UAT acceptance, residual-risk acceptance or final sign-off.
Notes: Record the exact release-candidate commit, UAT record, unresolved findings, accepted limitations, disabled-source list, decision details, authorised approver, decision date, conditions and immutable evidence reference. APR-15 cannot be approved during B0-05.
